en.purpose: To derive the clinical TNM sub-category string and corresponding stage group from the recorded T, N, and M categories for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma of non-head and neck skin, according to UICC 8th edition criteria.
en.use:
Use to classify cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the skin (non-head and neck region, excluding eyelid, perianal, vulva and penis) by selecting the appropriate clinical TNM categories:
- Clinical T category (Tx, T0, Tis, T1, T2, T3, T4a, T4b), based on tumour diameter and defined high-risk local extension criteria. T0 denotes an unknown primary tumour.
- Clinical N category (Nx, N0, N1, N2, N3), based on regional lymph node involvement and nodal metastasis size/distribution. N2 requires a single ipsilateral nodal metastasis > 3 cm and <= 6 cm, or multiple ipsilateral nodal metastases <= 6 cm.
- Clinical M category (M0, M1), based on presence of distant metastasis. Contralateral lymph node metastases are classified as M1 in non-head and neck skin cancer.

For T3, deep invasion means invasion below subcutaneous fat or > 6 mm depth, measured from the granular layer of adjacent normal epidermis to the tumour base. Qualifying perineural invasion means clinical or radiological involvement of named nerves without invasion of the foramina or skull base, or transgression, as specified in Table 3.

The guideline derives a TNM sub-category string and the TNM stage group (Stage 0-IVB) from the selected TNM categories using the UICC8 stage grouping table:
- Stage 0: Tis N0 M0
- Stage I: T1 N0 M0
- Stage II: T2 N0 M0
- Stage III: T3 N0 M0, or T1–T3 N1 M0
- Stage IVA: T1–T3 N2–N3 M0, or T4 Any N M0
- Stage IVB: Any T Any N M1

Limitation for multiple simultaneous tumours: select the highest T category manually. This guideline does not record the tumour count or append the parenthesised count required by Table 3 (for example, T2 (5)); record that notation separately. The TNM assessment output contains only the selected T, N, and M categories.
en.misuse: Not to be used for TNM classification of head and neck skin cancer, eyelid skin cancer, or cutaneous SCC in perianal, vulvar, or penile sites, as these have different UICC8 definitions and stage groupings.

other_details.en: A structured guideline used to assign the clinical Tumour-Node-Metastasis (TNM) categories and stage grouping for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the skin excluding head and neck region and eyelid, according to the UICC 8th edition definitions.
